knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Loading the Data
```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/CpG_overlap.csv')
overlap_cpg <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=NULL)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/DMPs_10.000.csv')
DMPs_10.000 <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
sig_BRCA_methylation_data <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original)%in%rownames(overlap_cpg)]
```


```{r}
# Subset der BRCA Methylierungsdaten
BRCA_data_DMP_1000 <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original)%in%rownames(DMPs_1000),]
```

```{r}
#Subset des Annotation Dataframes mit dem Type
#drop=FALSE behält die Dimensionen
tissue_types <- BRCA_sample_sheet[,7, drop=FALSE]
```

```{r}
# Bestimmung von Hypermethylation oder Hypomethylation aus dem logFC
overlap_cpg$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation' <- ifelse(overlap_cpg$logFC > 0, "Hypermethylation", "Hypomethylation")
```

```{r}
# Extrahieren der CpG_Ids aus overlap_cpg
significant_cpg_ids <- overlap_cpg$cpg_id

# Filtern der Zeilen in BRCA_methylation_data_original basierend auf den CpG_Ids in overlap_cpg
methylation_data_overlap <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) %in% significant_cpg_ids, ]
 
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper <-methylation_data_overlap

# Umwandeln der Zeilennamen in eine Spalte
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper$cpg_id <- rownames(methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper)

# Zusammenführen der Hypo/Hyper-Informationen aus overlap_cpg zu methylation_data_overlap
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper <- merge(methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper, overlap_cpg[, c("cpg_id", 'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation')], by = "cpg_id")

# Zeilennamen wiederherstellen und cpg_id-Spalte entfernen
rownames(methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper) <- methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper$cpg_id
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper$cpg_id <- NULL
```



Da wir nur die ersten 1000 CpGs ansehen, müssen wir methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper noch kürzen:
```{r}
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper_1000 <- methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper[1:1000, ]
```


```{r}
# Füge 'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation' als Faktor hinzu
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper_1000$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation' <- factor(methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper_1000$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation', levels = c("Hypomethylation", "Hypermethylation"))
```

```{r}
pca_1000_sigCpGs_Hypo_Hyper <- prcomp(BRCA_data_DMP_1000, scale. = TRUE)
head(pca_1000_sigCpGs_Hypo_Hyper$x)
```

```{r}
head(methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper_1000)#$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation'
```

```{r}
cpgs_pca <- rownames(BRCA_data_DMP_1000)
methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper_1000_sorted <- methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper[cpgs_pca,]
```
```{r}
cpgs_pca[1:10]
```

```{r}
rownames_pca <- rownames(BRCA_data_DMP_1000)
```

```{r}
rownames_2 <- rownames(methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper)
length(intersect(rownames_pca, rownames_2))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
#install.packages("factoextra")
library(factoextra)

pca_1000_sigCpGs_Hypo_Hyper <- prcomp(BRCA_data_DMP_1000, scale. = TRUE)

# Summary of the PCA results
summary(pca_1000_sigCpGs_Hypo_Hyper)

# Eigenvalues and Scree Plot
fviz_eig(pca_1000_sigCpGs_Hypo_Hyper)

# Converting Results into Dataframe
PCA_CpG_dataframe_Hypo_Hyper <- as.data.frame(pca_1000_sigCpGs_Hypo_Hyper$x)

custom_colors <- c("Hypomethylation" = "coral1", "Hypermethylation" = "chartreuse3")


# Plotting the PCA Results in a Biplot mit Färbung nach 'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation'
p <- ggplot(PCA_CpG_dataframe_Hypo_Hyper, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = methylation_data_overlap_hypo_hyper_1000_sorted$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation')) +
  geom_point(size = 1) + 
  labs(title = "PCA for CpG sites", x = "Principal Component 1", y = "Principal Component 2", color = NULL) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors)

ggsave("PCA_1000_CpG_sites_colored.pdf", plot = p, width = 7, height = 7)
p

```
